description: This file defines the 'Authorize' controller class within the admin mail namespace of the OpenCart system, responsible for handling email authorization-related functions such as sending verification or reset emails.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: `Authorize` class extends the base Controller class and manages email authorization processes such as sending and resetting authorization codes in the admin email module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles sending authorization emails based on the route, email, and code parameters. It prepares email content and utilizes the mail library to dispatch emails for authorization or confirmation purposes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Handles the process of resetting authorization, generating reset links with email and code parameters, and sending reset instructions via email.

calls: new 	heopencart	he system	he library	he Mail
